blocks.text: Model building is the process of creating simplified representations of complex problems. Focusing on the key elements helps us understand, analyze and solve real-world issues. This chapter covers models, basic statistics, collecting and preparing data, building and evaluating statistical models, and visualizing data.

blocks.prompt: What does a model leave out, and why?
blocks.explanation: Unnecessary details, so attention stays on the parts that matter most for the problem.

items: Model building: simplified representations of complex problems that keep the key elements.
